physical: For an ergodic system the long-time average of an observable equals its average over the ensemble of accessible states.
reflected_sentence: Expansion has a partner, but the complete relation does not.
rule_reason: An identity keeps its shape; the vocabulary maps time to Expansion but supplies no partners for ergodicity, observables, or either averaging construction.
closing: The identity rule selects keeps without importing assumptions from any other relation. Replacing the time component by Expansion does not define a long-time average or an ensemble average, and the absence of listed variables does not remove those unmapped terms from the statement.
